'''Toho Co., Ltd.''' ('''東宝株式会社''' ''Tōhō Kabushiki-gaisha'') is Japanese film, theater production and distribution company. This company serves as the distributor of [[Pokémon movie]]s in Japan.

==Pokémon and Toho==
The following is a list of Pokémon movies distributed by Toho in Japan:
* ''[[M01|Pokémon: The First Movie]]'' (1998)
* ''[[M02|Pokémon: The Movie 2000]]'' (1999)
* ''[[M03|Pokémon 3: The Movie]]'' (2000)
* ''[[M04|Pokémon 4Ever]]'' (2001)
* ''[[M05|Pokémon Heroes]]'' (2002)
* ''[[M06|Pokémon: Jirachi Wishmaker]]'' (2003)
* ''[[M07|Pokémon: Destiny Deoxys]]'' (2004)
* ''[[M08|Pokémon: Lucario and the Mystery of Mew]]'' (2005)
* ''[[M09|Pokémon Ranger and the Temple of the Sea]]'' (2006)
* ''[[M10|Pokémon: The Rise of Darkrai]]'' (2007)
* ''[[M11|Pokémon: Giratina and the Sky Warrior]]'' (2008)
* ''[[M12|Pokémon: Arceus and the Jewel of Life]]'' (2009)
* ''[[M13|Pokémon: Zoroark: Master of Illusions]]'' (2010)
* ''[[M14|Pokémon the Movie: Black—Victini and Reshiram]]'' (2011)
* ''[[M14|Pokémon the Movie: White—Victini and Zekrom]]'' (2011)
* ''[[M15|Pokémon the Movie: Kyurem vs. the Sword of Justice]]'' (2012)
* ''[[M16|Pokémon the Movie: Genesect and the Legend Awakened]]'' (2013)
* ''[[M17|Pokémon the Movie: Diancie and the Cocoon of Destruction]]'' (2014)
* ''[[M18|Pokémon the Movie: Hoopa and the Clash of Ages]]'' (2015)
* ''[[M19|Pokémon the Movie: Volcanion and the Mechanical Marvel]]'' (2016)
* ''[[M20|Pokémon the Movie: I Choose You!]]'' (2017)

* ''[[M22|Pokémon: Mewtwo Strikes Back—Evolution]]'' (2019)
* ''[[M23|Pokémon the Movie: Secrets of the Jungle]]'' (2020)
